environment.description: EKS pod in isolated private subnet routed exclusively through a Gateway VPC Endpoint for S3 (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3) with a restrictive endpoint policy. The endpoint policy uses aws:PrincipalOrgID condition and explicit resource scoping. Additionally, the pod's IRSA role has a permissions boundary that intersects with the endpoint policy. The VPC has no NAT gateway and no internet gateway, so all S3 traffic MUST traverse the VPC endpoint. The endpoint policy document restricts to a single application bucket with a source-VPC condition cross-referencing the specific endpoint ID.

config.network_config: no NAT gateway, no IGW, route table points 0.0.0.0/0 to blackhole, pl-63a5400a (S3 prefix list) routed to vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890
